Message.MsgText: Error initializing for automatic email of login information to new users.

Explanation.p: The feature for automatic email of login information to new users could not be initialized.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure that SMTP settings are correct. Check the full error message for details about this problem.

Message.MsgText: Client certificate attempted imported. FDS/VDI must be restarted whenever certificates are modified.

Explanation.p: An import of the client certificate was attempted. See the full message for details.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the full message to ensure that the certificate was successfully imported and then restart FDS/VDI.

Message.MsgText: Error sending email with login information to new user.

Explanation.p: An error occurred during automatic sending of the email with login information to a new user.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the full error message for details on this error. Ensure that the settings for message subject and body, as well as SMTP server details, are correct.

Explanation.p: The template used to create the subject for emails sent to newly provisioned users is incorrect.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure that the template text set for the subject of New User emails is correct.

Message.MsgText: Unable to write to the audit log file

Explanation.p: An error occurred when attempting to write to the audit log.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure that IBM Verify Directory Integrator has write permission to the LDAPSync/logs folder, and that there is sufficient free disk space available.

Message.MsgText: The URL that is specified is invalid.

Explanation.p: The format of the specified URL is incorrect.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure that the URL is in the correct format.

Explanation.p: The remote system is unreachable.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure that the hostname or IP address, and the port number specified are correct. Ensure that no firewalls are blocking the access.

Message.MsgText: This service requres an SSL connection. Use 'https://' in the URL.

Explanation.p: The remote server requires an SSL connection.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure that SSL is enabled for this connection. The SSL variant of the protocol specifier must be used for URL parameters.

Message.MsgText: The username and/or password that are specified are incorrect.

Explanation.p: The login credentials that are specified are incorrect.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure that the credentials that are specified are correct and have adequate permissions.

Message.MsgText: SSL is not supported by the remote system.

Explanation.p: An SSL connection has been specified, but is not supported by the remote system.

OperatorResponse.p: Use a non-secure connection setting.

Message.MsgText: The client certificate for this system is incorrect or has been in correctly imported followed by a restart of IBM Verify Directory Integrator.

Explanation.p: The client certificate is incorrect.

OperatorResponse.p: Remove the current certificate and import a new client certificate from the remote system again.

Message.MsgText: The Search Base that is specified is invalid.

Explanation.p: The Search Base that is specified is incorrect.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure that the Search Base that is specified is a valid DN value and that it refers to a node in the directory tree.

Explanation.p: The template used to create the body for emails sent to newly provisioned users is incorrect.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure that the template text set for the body of New User emails is correct.
